prereqs: KiCad 9 or 10, Node 18+, Python deps from requirements.txt. Clone and build (npm install && npm run build). JLCPCB_API_KEY is optional.
claude_code_command: claude mcp add --scope user kicad --env KICAD_PYTHON=<path to KiCad bundled python3> --env PYTHONPATH=<KiCad site-packages> -- node /path/to/KiCAD-MCP-Server/dist/index.js
note: Placeholders only. Never commit real keys; keep secrets in .env or the OS keychain.
